summary: Converts grayscale-plus-alpha texture data to 32-bit float RGBA. Computes the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050). Loops over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels, consuming two bytes per pixel: the first byte scaled by 0.0039215689 (the 1/255 float folded from flt_59E460) is written to all three RGB channels, and the second byte scaled by the same factor is written to the alpha channel, writing four floats per pixel. If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, calls ContactManifoldCleanup on the decoded float RGBA buffer.

operations.description: Compute the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050).
Iterate over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels, consuming two bytes per pixel (end pointer is src + 2 * this[1046]) and writing four floats per pixel.
Decode the grayscale value as the first pixel byte scaled by 0.0039215689 and write it to all three RGB channels of the output pixel.
Decode the alpha channel as the second pixel byte scaled by 0.0039215689, written to the alpha slot of the just-written output pixel.
Advance the input pointer by two bytes and the output pointer by four floats each iteration.
If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, run the post-processing cleanup on the decoded buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(this, output_base) where output_base is computed as the base of the decoded float RGBA buffer (a4 - 4 * this[1046]).
